import unittest
from users.model import User
from users.service import greeting
from users.serializer import dump_user
from users.importer import load
class Public(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_new_surface_and_compatibility(self):
  u=User('1', display_name='Ada'); self.assertEqual(u.name,'Ada')
  self.assertEqual(greeting(u),'Hello, Ada!')
  self.assertEqual(dump_user(u),{'id':'1','display_name':'Ada'})
  self.assertEqual(load({'id':'2','display_name':'Lin'}).display_name,'Lin')
 def test_name_is_read_only(self):
  u=User('1',display_name='Ada')
  with self.assertRaises((AttributeError, TypeError)): u.name='Other'
